requirement_summary: AI Target은 provider/model/deployment, system/developer/user prompt hierarchy, Tool Registry, Agent Memory, RAG corpus/index/embedding/chunking/retrieval policy를 version/digest로 고정한다. Provider alias나 이름 동일성만으로 model identity/currentness를 주장하지 않는다. (34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS17 AI Currentness sub-scope specifically: "AI Product CURRENT는 최소 다음 identity가 current여야 한다: model deployment, prompt bundle, tool registry, memory policy/backend, RAG stack, external provider contract, relevant validator qualification. 하나가 material drift이면 Product Composition currentness에 전파한다.")
subject: SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.aiProductCurrentnessCompose via assurance.ai-product.currentness-compose
coverage_notes: First closure of the Batch 5 'broader scope' (the 9 34_AI_RUNTIME... areas the batch5_object_d closure entry disclosed as genuinely uncovered: Prompt Provenance, Tool Authority Method, Agent Memory Assurance, RAG Assurance, AgentGraph/Delegation, AI Safety/Security claim separation, Judge/Reviewer Independence, Requalification Trigger, AI Currentness). Reuses the exact 6-state vocabulary (CURRENT/STALE/REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED/INVALIDATED/REVOKED/UNKNOWN) already established by contracts/currentness-snapshot.v1.schema.json (a general product/deployment currentness concept) but scopes composition to the 7 AI-specific sub-identity axes SS17 names, none of which currentness-snapshot.v1 itself tracks. Real computation: overall_currentness is CURRENT only when every one of the 7 axes is independently CURRENT; any other mix propagates using an explicit severity cascade (REVOKED > INVALIDATED > STALE > REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED > UNKNOWN) since SS17 states that drift propagates but does not itself define a cross-axis order for mixed-severity results. reasons lists EVERY non-CURRENT axis (not only those at the worst tier) -- aiProductCurrentnessComposeWorstTierWinsButReasonsListsEveryDriftedAxis proves a REVOKED axis and a separately STALE axis both appear in reasons even though only REVOKED becomes overall_currentness, matching this session's established 'aggregate, do not short-circuit' precedent (FR-META-041). Each axis value is validated against the full 6-state vocabulary before comparison (requiredCurrentnessState, new helper) rather than read as free text -- aiProductCurrentnessComposeRejectsAnUnrecognizedAxisValue proves an unrecognized value fails closed with an exception rather than silently matching no severity tier and leaving overall_currentness at its CURRENT default (a real fail-open bug caught and fixed during this method's own design, before any test was written against it).
open_gap: This operation composes caller-supplied per-axis currentness states; it does not itself observe or compute any axis's currentness from a real running system (no live model-deployment/prompt-bundle/tool-registry/memory/RAG-stack/provider-contract/validator-qualification observer exists in this codebase to feed it, mirroring the same 'operates on caller-supplied representations, not live system reads' pattern already disclosed for Provider Drift and Multi-Agent Corroboration in Batch 5 slice 5). The severity cascade (REVOKED > INVALIDATED > STALE > REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED > UNKNOWN) is an inferred, disclosed convention, not literally specified by SS17 or by doc 38's Currentness Domain C section (neither document orders the 6 states by severity).
design_reference_gap: 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md is itself Status: DESIGN_ONLY/DRAFT/NON_FINAL (and SS19 explicitly states 'this document does not itself declare actual qualification') -- this closure builds real, tested conformance-checking infrastructure against its SS17 rule, consistent with how every self_validation_nonfinal/PASS_NONFINAL gate this session has been built against other draft-status design docs, but does not and cannot finalize the parent document itself.
